stem:
Vihaan watches two changes in the lab.
Change P: sugar crystals dissolve completely in a glass of water; the water tastes sweet and no new solid appears.
Change Q: a strip of magnesium burns in air with a bright flame and leaves a white powder.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Change P is physical because no new substance forms.
Change Q is chemical because a new substance (the white powder) forms.
Change Q is physical because burning only rearranges the same magnesium strip.
Change P is chemical because the sugar no longer looks like crystals.

teacher.key_rationale: Dissolving sugar forms no new substance; burning magnesium forms a new white powder.
